title: Playwright specs must deep-traverse shadow roots for Cell subtitle surfaces — the split-view panel host and #cell-subtitle-root are shadow hosts, and term-based CSS selectors break on apostrophes
trigger: An e2e spec queries subtitle tokens or the split-view panel with document.querySelector/locator and finds zero elements even though they are rendered
principle: Cell subtitle UI lives in shadow roots (#cell-subtitle-root, [data-cell-split-view="panel"]). document.querySelector cannot pierce them — use a recursive page.evaluate walker that descends every element's shadowRoot, or locate the host first and query inside its shadowRoot. For term lookups never build [data-cell-term="..."] CSS selectors — subtitle terms contain apostrophes/quotes that break the selector; match getAttribute('data-cell-term') in JS instead. When the host page's layout occludes a token's clickable point, dispatch a composed MouseEvent directly on the element — it still exercises the real React/DOM handler.

cases.context: subtitle-bulk-status e2e: all token counts read 0 until helpers walked shadow roots recursively; the term "isn't" crashed a CSS selector; real clicks on cue-list tokens hit the mock page's _playerSection overlay so a composed dispatch was used.

applyFor: any e2e spec asserting inside Cell subtitle overlay/split-view/Player Mode surfaces
